_comment: Counted error baseline for `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`. Mirrors the migration-prefix-collisions baseline pattern. The CI gate (scripts/ci/typecheck-no-regression.mjs) fails if a PR raises the count above this baseline. PRs that REDUCE the count should run `npm run ci:typecheck:write-baseline` so the new lower number lands and ratchets the bar tighter for the next PR. Goal over time: 0.
